10.2.6 EcuMResetMode
SWS Item
[ECUC_EcuM_00172]
Container Name
EcuMResetMode
Parent Container
EcuMFlexConfiguration
Description
These containers describe the configured reset modes. The name of these containers
allows one of the following symbolic names to be given to the different reset modes:
• ECUM_RESET_MCU
• ECUM_RESET_WDG
• ECUM_RESET_IO.
